WHEREAS, the Town of Sharpsburg has adopted a comprehensive building and construction code codified at Chapter 23 of the Town of Sharpsburg Code of Ordinance; and

WHEREAS, the Town Council has determined that to serve the needs of the community certain amendments are needed in the Town's Code of Ordinances; and

WHEREAS, these amendments to the building and construction ordinance to adopt the International Property Maintenance Code is necessary to further the general health and welfare of the community; and

WHEREFORE, THE TOWN OF SHARPSBURG HEREBY ADOPTS, ORDAINS AND ENACTS THE FORGOING AMENDMENT TO THE BUILDING AND CONSTRUCTION ORDINANCE AS FOLLOWS:
5: The Town of Sharpsburg’s Zoning Ordinance, as codified at Chapter 23-102 of the Town’s Code of Ordinances is hereby amended by deleting the stricken language (sttiekentanguage) and adding the double underlined (double underlined) language as follows:

This Ordinance shall become immediately effective upon its second reading and adoption by the Mayor and Town Council.

The Preamble of this Ordinance shall be construed to be, and is hereby incorporated by reference as is fully set out herein.
8: The Ordinance shall be codified within the Code of Ordinances of the Town of Sharpsburg, Georgia at Chapter 9 in a manner consistent with the laws of the State of Georgia and of the Town of Sharpsburg.
9: If any section, subsection, sentence, clause, phrase, or other portion of this ordinance for any reason is held invalid or unconstitutional by court of competent jurisdiction, such portion shall be deemed as a separate, distinct, and independent provision, and such holding shall not affect the validity of the remaining portion hereof.
